title: Töödokument - Parandus - CORRIGENDUM This document corrects document SWD(2025) 8 final of 30.1.2025. This document incorrectly referred to the Former Yugoslav Republic of Macedonia rather than North Macedonia on pp. 55-56, 108, and 173. The text shall read as follows: North Macedonia COMMISSION STAFF WORKING DOCUMENT Comprehensive data sets related to export controls of dual-use items for the year 2022 Accompanying the document REPORT FROM THE COMMISSION TO THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND THE COUNCIL on the implementation of Regulation (EU) 2021/821 setting up a Union regime for the control of exports, brokering, technical assistance, transit and transfer of dual-use items - SWD(2025) 8, COM(2025) 19
